derivation: A deterministic offline simulation of seed 31 / Level 1 was used to derive timestamps from the policy: launch at 0 ms; thereafter tap on a downward crossing of global player y=320 when at least 240 ms has elapsed since the preceding tap. The live browser runner does not read __GAME_TEST__, state, coordinates, or gameplay events to decide any scheduled input.
runtimePolicy: Each item is a normal touch/mouse tap at viewport center on the game surface. Absolute offsets are measured from fresh page navigation. No adaptive gameplay input is sent.
